answer: The quartz-orchard: each identity is bound to one physical device whose quartz oscillator drift fingerprint is enrolled at registration — a 90-dollar device plus 3 hours of drift calibration per fake, and no farm can parallelize it since each crystal’s drift is unique and temperature-dependent. Each epoch the garden of enrolled devices is re-measured: a device whose drift no longer matches its baseline is pruned. Cloning one fingerprint means buying and calibrating a new crystal for every fake, one at a time.
